Build Cost Matrix (+1 hop)

Local+1+2+3

Live-market build cost of every item and ship at every station. BoM = from raw ore; Recipe = buy sub-assemblies. Muted = can't complete from current depth.

Each tab pools sell-order depth from stations within N jumps of the column's home station; cost is the cheapest sourcing within reach. Savings/Profit always compare against the finished good at the home station.
